name: burnout-league
description: Burnout League — season-long fantasy football with the burn mechanic

scripts.build:server: npm run db:generate && npm -w packages/shared run build && npm -w packages/db run build && npm -w packages/burn-engine run build && npm -w packages/scoring-engine run build && npm -w packages/leaderboard run build && npm -w packages/payments run build && npm -w packages/api run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/burn-engine/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/scoring-engine/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/leaderboard/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/payments/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/api/tsconfig.test.json
